title: Dinner Lady Purple Rain Short Fill
description: Dinner Lady Vape Juice Purple Rain 50ml Treat your taste buds to a dance in the (purple) rain with this beautiful berry blend from the Dinner Lady Fruits range. Packed with luscious fruits to shower your senses in deep purple flavour, this shortfill serving is alive with notes of succulent blueberry, tangy raspberry a squeeze of zingy lemon juice. A convenient 50ml bottle keeps you suitably drenched in sumptuous sub ohm servings and provides the option to add a nicotine shot so you can tailor your vape to suit your vaping needs. All while your taste buds are bathing in the purple rain!
